method: composite (no AI re-rendering); original photo pixels kept everywhere except the masked glass area
mask: Luminance threshold (blown-out windscreen, lum > 205) above the dash line with small-hole filling; steering wheel, wiper and thin wire kept.
fill: smooth neutral light-grey studio gradient (tones [214, 228, 230, 224], horizon at source y=200), slight per-window glass tint, faint low-frequency reflection (6% of the original glass luminance variation), light grain
watermark: Galaxy S24+ / time text removed by OpenCV Telea inpaint limited to the text pixels in the bottom-left corner (mostly outside the crop)
